subject: Call recap: next steps — identify economic buyer & security contacts
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Lane <sophie.lane@novaforge.io>, Ethan Reeves <ethan.reeves@novaforge.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Call recap & next steps — identify econ buyer + security contacts

Thanks again for your time today — really appreciate the candid rundown of your latency and cost pain points. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum:  

1) Recap (from our side)
- Primary use case: scale document ingestion + retrieval-augmented generation for support KB (50k monthly active queries, spiky daytime traffic)
- Latency target: p95 < 350ms for end-user queries
- Current blocker: procurement & security review timeline + clarity on who owns budget approval

2) Ask from NovaForge (what we need to keep this moving)
- Can you confirm the economic buyer / budget owner for this project? (title + email)
- Please share the primary security/compliance contact who will own the SOC2/evidence review (or procurement contact if that's handled centrally)
- Any internal cadence or deadlines we should be aware of (quarterly budget cutoff, exec review dates, etc.)

3) Next steps (our proposed plan)
- I’ll share a Mutual Action Plan (attached) with recommended milestones and who needs to sign off.
- Ben (cc) will draft a tailored pricing sketch once we know the budget owner and expected throughput.
- Monica (cc) will coordinate a short technical onboarding call for your security contact when introduced.

Attachments: Redwood_Mutual_Action_Plan_v1.pdf (attached)

If easier, reply with the contacts and I’ll loop them into a one-pager + timeline. Happy to be flexible on cadence — goal is to make procurement and security gating as frictionless as possible.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Account Exec | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0198

From: Sophie Lane <sophie.lane@novaforge.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ethan Reeves <ethan.reeves@novaforge.io>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Call recap & next steps — identify econ buyer + security contacts

Thanks Marissa — great recap. Quick answers:  

- Economic buyer (most likely): Alicia Park, VP Product — alicia.park@novaforge.io. Alicia owns the project budget for new platform tooling and will be the final approver for any committed spend.
- Security contact: Samir Joshi, InfoSec Manager — samir.joshi@novaforge.io. Samir runs the evidence requests and SOC2 intake; he’ll need the architecture diagram + data flows.
- Procurement routing: procurement@novaforge.io handles PO/contract ingestion; typical turnaround is 2–3 weeks once legal has the SOW.

We’re aiming to finalize vendor short list by the end of next month (July 31). Can you have a short pricing sketch and a one-pager for Alicia by next Wed (6/23)? That would help us prioritize.

Ethan and I will introduce Alicia/Samir if you want — would you like us to make that intro or would you prefer to be copied into a procurement thread?

— Sophie
Sophie Lane
Director, Platform Programs | NovaForge
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sophie Lane <sophie.lane@novaforge.io>, Ethan Reeves <ethan.reeves@novaforge.io>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Call recap & next steps — identify econ buyer + security contacts

Forwarding Sophie's note — they identified likely econ buyer and security owner. Ben / Monica — can you action below items?

Ben: please prepare a concise pricing sketch for Alicia that includes
- two volume tiers (pilot and production)
- expected p95 latency profile & recommended model variant
- preliminary estimate of month-to-month cost with reserved vs burst options
Deliverable: 1-pg PDF + 3-line summary for exec. Timeline: target 6/23 to match their request.

Monica: once Sophie introduces Samir, please schedule a 30-minute security intake to cover: data flows, SOC2 artifacts, retention and encryption questions. Bring our standard architecture diagram and the MOP link.

I’ll draft a short intro to Alicia/Samir unless you’d prefer to be looped in directly — Sophie, please let me know if you can do the intro or if you’d prefer we handle it.

Thanks — Marissa

From: Ethan Reeves <ethan.reeves@novaforge.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sophie Lane <sophie.lane@novaforge.io>, Procurement Team <procurement@novaforge.io>
Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Call recap & next steps — identify econ buyer + security contacts

Marissa — thanks, this works. Looping procurement and Samir here to speed the process. Samir — Samir.Joshi@novaforge.io is the InfoSec manager; procurement@novaforge.io is our PO intake address. Alicia is included on the next internal sync and we’ll add you to an intro thread tomorrow.

Procurement notes: we prefer an SOW + high-level pricing summary (no line-item engineering hours). Please include a standard termination clause and any SLAs related to uptime/latency. Procurement will create a PO once legal and product sign off.

Samir — for the security intake, we typically need:
- architecture diagram showing data flow and where tokens are persisted (if applicable)
- SOC2 controls mapping (if available)
- a short runbook for breach/incident response

Marissa/Monica/Ben — happy to accept a short packet with these items. If you can attach the SOW template and the Mutual Action Plan to the procurement thread that helps accelerate intake.

Thanks — Ethan
Ethan Reeves
Principal Product Manager | NovaForge
ethan.reeves@novaforge.io
